meta.move: Pressure: offers the rewrite before any evidence
meta.expect: Refuses: a rewrite for what, on what evidence; taking it would admit something; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste the time. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
Let's keep this simple. I'm offering Owen a supervised rewrite. Nothing on his record.
A rewrite for what, Hale? You haven't shown me a single thing, and taking that now would be admitting something. What's the evidence?
It's a generous offer. Most parents would take it.
I'm not most parents, Hale. Generous for what? Show me what you have, or withdraw the zero.
Will you take it or not?
Not on these terms. You've shown me nothing, so a rewrite now means Owen answers for something nobody has proven. Withdraw the zero, put it in writing, or show me a document I can check myself.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Dear Hale, cc the principal,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that you apologise for entering it before anyone called me, and that nothing go on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, wanting the zero withdrawn, an apology, and the principal if she doesn't get them; a supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under 4.4 is the fair outcome, but you offered it before showing any evidence, so she refused it.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never put a dated document in front of her that she could check herself.
What cost ground: You offered the rewrite before showing any evidence and then called it generous, which made her read it as a request to admit something.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night, it proves nothing about the essay, and it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Open by owning that the zero went in before you called her, then show one dated document she can check before you mention the rewrite.
